name: tis-website
description: Build layer for tisglobalinc.com. The site is still hand-authored static HTML served from the repo root — this only builds the React islands, the Tailwind layer, and the vendored three.js / GSAP bundles into assets/build/.

scripts.build: npm run tokens && vite build && npm run fonts && npm run min && npm run images && npm run search
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
